name: subscriptions_sdk
_comment_version_1_7_1: 1.7.0 -> 1.7.1: a seller's shop purchase no longer touches the student's subscription row (supacharge verification item 7c). SubscriptionsRepository._cacheOwnSubscription writes the subscribe_my_shop result to its own KV box SubscriptionsRepository.shopSubscriptionBox ('shop_subscriptions', keyed by user id) instead of the shared 'user_subscriptions' row, which the lms host fills from lms's my_entitlements; a shop purchase used to merge `active`/`expiryDate` into that row and could flip a student's active flag. Server side (subscriptions/frappe, item 8): api.subscription subscribe_my_shop's _charge_wallet reads the Wallet with frappe.get_doc(..., for_update=True) and checks the balance only under that row lock, so two concurrent purchases cannot overspend. No new cmd; wire shape unchanged.
_comment_version_1_6_0: 1.5.0 -> 1.6.0: the purchase dialog's payment-method radio row is now the public lib widget SubscriptionPaymentMethodRow (exported from the barrel), coloured through the theme seams (Theme.of(context).brightness with AppStyle.inkFor / secondaryInkFor / strokeFor) instead of the dark-only textDarkSecondary / strokeDarkSubtle. The installed payment_dialog.dart template renders it with the same icons and hints; loyalty_sdk 1.1.0's customer plan checkout reuses it. No route, table or cmd changed.
_comment_version_1_5_0: 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0: demo runs the REAL SubscriptionsRepository (Ray, 2026-09-25: touch all SDK demos, remove unused files; the tour must not use mock repos). subscriptionRepositoryProvider now answers SubscriptionsRepository over base_sdk's HttpService Dio (and the registered AppDatabase, registered lazily when absent) unless the host overrides it; SubscriptionsSdkDependencies registers assets/demo/subscriptions with DemoFixtures, and base_sdk 1.73.0's DemoGatewayInterceptor answers api.subscription.list_subscriptions and api.subscription.subscribe_my_shop from templates/assets/demo/subscriptions/<cmd>.json while DemoSession.demoActive. DemoSubscriptionsRepository is deleted. Kept: DemoSubscriptionPaymentsProvider and the demo UI callbacks (wallet price, web view, error, translation), which have no platform cmd in this SDK, and createTransaction's legacy non-gateway path. Requires base_sdk >= 1.73.0.
_comment_version_1_4_0: 1.3.1 -> 1.4.0: the six unoverridden riverpod providers in src/common/application/subscriptions/subscriptions_provider.dart (subscriptionRepositoryProvider, paymentsRepositoryProvider, walletPriceProvider, navigateToWebViewProvider, errorNotificationProvider, translationProvider) resolve their demo fallback from base_sdk's RUNTIME DemoSession.demoActive (demo BUILD OR demo SESSION) instead of the compile-time AppConstants.isDemo alone, so a server-marked demo account that signs in on the production backend is served the in-app fixtures on /subscriptions the same way a demo build is. The host-must-override contract is unchanged: without a demo build or session each provider still throws UnimplementedError, and a host adapter installed as a ProviderScope override never runs these bodies at all. A riverpod Provider body runs ONCE and its result (including a thrown error) is cached for the container's life, so the switch cannot be read inline: new demoActiveProvider is the bridge - a plain Provider<bool> (not a ChangeNotifierProvider, which would dispose the app-wide DemoSession singleton with the first container) that subscribes to DemoSession.instance and calls ref.invalidateSelf() on each notification, dropping its own cached value and that of every watcher so the next read re-decides. Each of the six ref.watches it BEFORE deciding, which is also what registers the subscription on the read that throws. The import moved from package:base_sdk/src/constants/app_constants.dart to the public package:base_sdk/base_sdk.dart barrel, retiring the package's only implementation_imports analyzer hit. Requires base_sdk >= 1.61.0 (DemoSession). New subscriptions_provider_demo_session_test covers the three states - no session throws, an active session yields the demo implementations, and a session that starts AFTER the first read is still picked up (two of its four cases fail against 1.3.1) - plus that a host override is untouched either way. DemoSubscriptionsRepository's own doc comment, which still pointed at the retired constant, now names the same runtime switch. No manifest key, route, install, table or migration changed.
